capsule.purpose: Produce a bounded, read-only diagnosis of an existing design without claiming verification or acceptance.
context_order: Finding-specific implementation fragments only after an upgrade
exit_gate: the result is labeled advisory or self-reviewed
uninspected implementation and unrun tests are explicit
material Findings have evidence and an upgrade recommendation
prohibited: Modify code, data, schemas, configuration, or project state.
Run tests, builds, migrations, or production commands.
Create or update Tasks, Reviews, Findings, or reports on disk.
Claim independent Review, formal acceptance, completion, production readiness, or approval.
upgrade_triggers: a request to change code, data, schema, or configuration
a request for tests, independent Review, acceptance, completion, or production readiness
a current-action risk requiring authorization, persistence, or a formal gate

privacy-or-regulated-data: data classification, minimization, access, retention, and disclosure
security-critical: authentication, authorization, trust boundaries, abuse cases, and secrets
production-destructive: destructive transitions, safeguards, recovery, and operator authority
difficult-to-reverse: rollback feasibility, compensating actions, and recovery time
external-user-impact: user-visible states, compatibility, notification, and support recovery
financial-impact: value conservation, settlement states, reconciliation, retries, and audit evidence
shared-interface-or-migration: compatibility, ordering, migration states, rollback, and mixed-version behavior
ambiguous-material-requirements: unresolved decisions, ownership, invariants, and acceptance boundaries
weak-or-missing-verification: unproven assumptions, missing observability, and recommended targeted checks
unfamiliar-technology: technology-specific failure modes and unsupported assumptions
authority-or-external-communication: decision authority, credentials, external effects, and risk acceptance
